Optima 880   Owner Guide (synthetic)

Model overview
The Optima 880 is part of the 880 Series of hot tubs in this synthetic guide.
Every 880 Series model shares the same heater and control panel.

Panel messages
FLO:  The heater senses no water flow. Clean or replace the filter cartridge, then check that the circulation pump runs.
If FLO returns after cleaning, call a technician. Do not bypass the flow switch.
COOL: Water is 20 degrees below the set point.
ICE:	Water is near freezing; the pumps run to protect the plumbing.

Filter care
Rinse the filter cartridge every 2 weeks and replace it every 12 months.
